reference_sql:
SELECT sa.order_month AS month,
  SUM(CASE WHEN st.country_code = 'NL' THEN sa.net_revenue_eur ELSE 0 END) AS nl_revenue_eur,
  SUM(CASE WHEN st.country_code = 'BE' THEN sa.net_revenue_eur ELSE 0 END) AS be_revenue_eur,
  SUM(CASE WHEN st.country_code = 'LU' THEN sa.net_revenue_eur ELSE 0 END) AS lu_revenue_eur
FROM sales sa
JOIN stores st ON st.store_code = sa.store_code
WHERE sa.order_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-01-01' AND DATE '2025-12-31'
GROUP BY sa.order_month
alternatives:
SELECT month, COALESCE(nl, 0) AS nl_revenue_eur, COALESCE(be, 0) AS be_revenue_eur, COALESCE(lu, 0) AS lu_revenue_eur
FROM (
  -- one row per order line of 2025
  SELECT sa.order_month AS month, st.country_code, sa.net_revenue_eur
  FROM sales sa
  JOIN stores st ON st.store_code = sa.store_code
  WHERE sa.order_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-01-01' AND DATE '2025-12-31'
) AS r
PIVOT (SUM(net_revenue_eur) FOR country_code IN ('NL' AS nl, 'BE' AS be, 'LU' AS lu) GROUP BY month)

SELECT sa.order_month AS month,
  COALESCE(SUM(sa.net_revenue_eur) FILTER (WHERE st.country_code = 'NL'), 0) AS nl_revenue_eur,
  COALESCE(SUM(sa.net_revenue_eur) FILTER (WHERE st.country_code = 'BE'), 0) AS be_revenue_eur,
  COALESCE(SUM(sa.net_revenue_eur) FILTER (WHERE st.country_code = 'LU'), 0) AS lu_revenue_eur
FROM sales sa
JOIN stores st ON st.store_code = sa.store_code
WHERE sa.order_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-01-01' AND DATE '2025-12-31'
GROUP BY sa.order_month

solver.query:
SELECT date_trunc('month', s.order_date)::DATE AS month,
  COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN st.country_code = 'NL' THEN s.net_revenue_eur END), 0) AS nl_revenue_eur,
  COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN st.country_code = 'BE' THEN s.net_revenue_eur END), 0) AS be_revenue_eur,
  COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN st.country_code = 'LU' THEN s.net_revenue_eur END), 0) AS lu_revenue_eur
FROM sales s JOIN stores st ON st.store_code = s.store_code
WHERE s.order_date >= DATE '2025-01-01' AND s.order_date < DATE '2026-01-01'
  AND st.country_code IN ('NL','BE','LU')
GROUP BY 1
